test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

We will not remind you again.

options.text: You will not be reminded by us again.
You will not remind us again.
You will not have reminded us again.
You will not be reminding us again.

solution:
The correct answer is **option 1 i.e. You will not be reminded by us again.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **active** **voice**. As per the question we have to change it into **passive** **voice**.
